title: Buyer-cost-first scan — paid internal external-supply coordination
purpose: Continue buyer-cost-first using direct current operating evidence. Bind named Xuzhou/Jiangsu companies that are actively paying dedicated humans to solve recurring supplier, external-manufacturing, quality, delivery or export-coordination work. Then test whether mature external platforms leave an observed residual that a new orchestration layer could own.
scan_rule: PAID INTERNAL COORDINATOR != EXTERNAL ROUTING WHITESPACE
PLATFORM COVERAGE + INTERNAL HIRING = RESIDUAL QUESTION, NOT RESIDUAL PROOF
Retain nothing without an observed post-incumbent missing edge.

bound_paid_workaround_events.actor: 江苏微迈思半导体科技有限公司
current_evidence: A current recruitment page lists five openings for external-procurement supervisors at RMB 7,000-10,000 per person.

The role covers supplier development and negotiation, order placement, production-process tracking, outsourced-part procurement, inbound confirmation, quality acceptance, abnormal-quality closure, budgeting and cost control.
A second current external-procurement-supervisor listing requires end-to-end capability from new-product development through shipment.
current_incumbent_counterevidence: HAIZOL currently provides non-standard-part supplier discovery, quote comparison, engineer assistance, NDA support, production-node tracking and one-stop delivery.

IMEfuture currently provides non-standard procurement project management, external-production progress visibility, supplier delivery-risk control, receiving/inspection coordination, supplier scoring and sourcing.
bound_paid_workaround_events.unknown: Public evidence does not show whether the company has tried these external platforms/services, why internal responsibility remains necessary, or whether it would externalize the role.

bound_paid_workaround_events.actor: 江苏通扬装备科技有限公司
current_evidence: A current supplier-development role is dedicated to machining, welding, castings, standard parts, electrical components and outsourced processing.
The role explicitly exists to develop new and backup suppliers, reduce single-source risk, compare prices, audit supplier qualifications and sites, and continuously manage supplier performance.
A current recruitment aggregator shows the Xuzhou supplier-development role around RMB 6,000-7,000.
current_incumbent_counterevidence: HAIZOL offers factory databases, supplier matching, quote comparison and verified manufacturing resources.
IMEfuture offers sourcing, supplier databases and supplier-performance management for non-standard procurement.
bound_paid_workaround_events.unknown: The reason a current external platform cannot replace or materially reduce this in-house role is not publicly attributable.

bound_paid_workaround_events.actor: 格利尔数码科技股份有限公司
current_evidence: The company's 2026 half-year report states that some magnetic-component production is outsourced because of capacity limits; it selects external suppliers after considering process complexity and required capacity.

A current external-planning role dynamically allocates orders across external factories based on internal load, supplier capacity and lead time; it tracks material, quality, delivery, rework and supplier performance.
current_incumbent_counterevidence: HAIZOL and IMEfuture currently productize supplier discovery, non-standard procurement, progress visibility and delivery-risk management.
bound_paid_workaround_events.unknown: Current evidence proves the control-plane function and recurring external flow, but not a market gap that a third party can own better than the firm's internal planner.

bound_paid_workaround_events.actor: 徐州信航国际贸易有限公司
current_evidence: A current business-assistant role pays RMB 4,000-7,000 and combines domestic supplier development, supplier comparison/follow-up, complete export-document preparation, contract handling, CAD checking and data analysis.
current_incumbent_counterevidence: Supplier-discovery platforms, freight forwarders, customs agents, trade SaaS and export-service providers already cover large parts of this workflow.

rejected_or_closed_events.actor: 江苏呜咔咔宠物用品有限公司
rejected_or_closed_events.event: The company had difficulty identifying entry standards across export countries.
rejected_or_closed_events.current_solution: Xuzhou Customs currently provides targeted standard guidance, remote inspection and cloud certification that compress clearance time and logistics cost.

rejected_or_closed_events.actor: 江苏中科智储科技有限公司
rejected_or_closed_events.event: A current role offers RMB 8,000 base plus commission for a full-factory industrial-ice sales contractor responsible for selling 500 tonnes/day, channel building, inventory absorption and collections.
rejected_or_closed_events.reason_rejected: RESOURCE_SIDE_SALES_CHANNEL_EVENT; not used to satisfy BUYER COST FIRST, and the role would pull Rooter toward founder-heavy sales/distribution execution without an observed missing edge.

material_learning: Direct recruitment data is a high-signal sensor because it shows what firms are currently willing to pay humans to own.
Xuzhou manufacturers are repeatedly paying for supplier sourcing, backup-source development, external capacity allocation, quality acceptance, progress tracking and exception closure.
This strongly validates recurring supplier/external-production orchestration as a real economic function.
Current industrial platforms already productize much of the same functional surface.
The continued existence of internal roles does not by itself prove an externalizable gap: the reason internal responsibility persists remains unknown.
A new router cannot be promoted merely by proposing that it replace a procurement employee.
cross_industry_result.current_best_next_truth: Fresh Scan 026 should stay cost-first but prefer CURRENT EXTERNALIZED WORKAROUNDS: named Xuzhou/Jiangsu private actors already paying a third party repeatedly for supplier, logistics, inspection, compliance, sales-channel or other coordination responsibility, where current evidence also shows dissatisfaction, fallback behavior, multi-provider switching or another post-provider residual. This is closer to proven external willingness-to-pay than internal hiring.
